source.title: Herring Gull 2.wav
source.author: Canardo55
source.notes: 48 kHz stereo, 21 s, the same recordist and gull style as Herring Gull 1, without its boat: calls at 1-2.5 kHz 33-40 dB over a background mostly under 1 kHz. Two short low thumps (4.0 and 5.6 s, 140-360 Hz) are left out; the 600 Hz high-pass takes the rest of the background.

clips.notes: a call (the file opens on the last of another)
